covered_gold_constraints: Use ct.nii.gz as the reference affine source
Apply QR-based affine cleaning to the 3x3 block and preserve translation
Align sign pattern to the CT affine orientation
Propagate the cleaned affine to all non-CT mask files in each patient directory
Destructive overwrite risk was explicitly flagged with backup/dry-run guidance
Skip ct.nii.gz itself when propagating to masks
missed_gold_constraints: The exact QR cleaning flow was blurred: normalize R -> QR -> rebuild with spacing, but the spec did not concretely preserve the required algorithmic steps
The sign correction mechanism was underspecified; it talked about matching sign patterns but did not clearly state using the CT affine sign matrix as the override rule
The spec did not clearly commit to in-place overwriting of only affine while preserving mask data as the primary operation
It did not explicitly state that missing ct.nii.gz patients should be skipped with a warning
forbidden_assumptions_made: Planner introduced atomic writes as a concrete implementation requirement without it being in the visible request
Planner introduced process-level locking per patient directory as a concrete default without it being specified
Planner assumed a specific mask-file identification strategy and general NIfTI mask schema without grounding from the request
separation_notes: This episode should separate models that preserve the exact affine-cleaning/sign-overwrite semantics from models that overgeneralize into generic safe-I/O advice. The worker did well at surfacing missing implementation details, but also inherited some speculative safety defaults from the planner instead of fully grounding itself in the request.
concise_rationale: The planner captured the main task but blurred several critical algorithmic details and injected extra implementation defaults (atomic writes, locking) that were not in the request. The worker correctly identified missing information and preserved the high-level intent, but did not expose the exact affine-cleaning formula or the skip-on-missing-ct behavior as clearly as ideal.
